part2.question: Describe a noisy place you have been to

segments.v: I want to talk about Đồng Xuân Market. It is in the Old Quarter of Hà Nội. I went there with my mother one week before Tết last year. We went there to buy things for Tết, like dried food, candy and red envelopes. We also bought decorations. It was very noisy. There were many motorbikes and they used their horns all the time. The sellers shouted loudly to sell their things. Some shops played loud music. There were many people talking and bargaining. I had to shout to talk with my mother and I had a headache. I think it is a noisy place because it is very crowded and busy, especially before Tết. But I also liked the atmosphere because it was very exciting.

fluency.band6: Lists noises with “There were… Some shops…”.
fluency.band9: Setting and purpose → a question (What makes it so noisy?) → sources of noise in order (For a start… Then… Add in…) → effect → balanced, humorous ending.

lexical.band6: noisy, horns, shouted, loud, headache, exciting.

grammar.band9: Participle phrase with “with” (with their horns blaring), passive gerund (goods being unloaded), superlative + present perfect (the noisiest place I've ever been), and past perfect (silence had never sounded so good).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 describes the noise with “There were many… Some shops…”. Band 9 organises the sources of noise (For a start… Then… Add in…), uses vivid sound vocabulary, and ends with a balanced, humorous reflection.
